Class SynchronizationChecks

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.SynchronizationChecks
public final class SynchronizationChecks extends Object
Wire boundaries, independent of forgiving saved-world recovery.

  • Method Details

    • configSnapshotsRoundTripAndPublishAtomically

      public static void configSnapshotsRoundTripAndPublishAtomically(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Complete snapshots publish flags and both lists only at their final chunk. To reproduce in-game: configure disabled types and namespace lists, join, and inspect mode cycling and /ss write list. A large list exercises multiple packets; exact atomicity requires this test.

    • configStagingChecksSequencesAndTotals

      public static void configStagingChecksSequencesAndTotals(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Missing, inconsistent, and superseded generations cannot publish partial settings. No in-game reproduction applies: these are synthetic interrupted and malformed sequences.
